release_notes: Build 119 removes the old-screen startup flash by keeping the main window visually hidden until the current Factburst navigation has been assembled.
The first visible frame now uses the current Autopilot, Create, Performance, Library, Website, Analytics, Users, Comments, SEO, Advanced, and Settings shell.
Publication State is now available from Library / Quiz History for the selected quiz instead of depending on the hidden legacy Upload Manager page.
No separate Upload Manager is added to the current Factburst sidebar; existing internal upload and retry workflows remain compatible.
Build 118 unified publication state and Build 117 permanent project folders remain included unchanged.
